name: youmustreadthis
description: Derek Neighbors' curated list of books you must read (youmustreadthis.com), built with Jekyll and Tailwind CSS.

scripts.build: npm run build:jekyll && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: npm run build && (bundle exec jekyll serve --skip-initial-build --watch --livereload --port 4000 & tailwindcss -i src/style.css -o _site/assets/css/style.css --watch=always)

author: Derek Neighbors / Integrum
